protocol.aggregate: Arithmetic mean across three model seeds, equivalently target-weighted over all three equal-length predictions; same TEST bytes are repeated measures, not independent corpora
baselines: TRAIN-only trigram with fresh-TUNE selected smoothing
equal-weight probability ensemble of all three neural checkpoints
protocol.ensemble_cost: Requires all three neural forward passes, separately stated; no inexpensive-ensemble or faster-inference claim
protocol.ensemble_selection: Same count-weight grid and tie rule fitted once on fresh TUNE; neural ensemble probabilities arithmetic mean of all three checkpoints
protocol.interval_convention: zero-based half-open; TUNE and TEST are distinct official splits; neither suffix was used previously
protocol.mixture: P=(1-w)*P_neural+w*P_trigram, same scalar w for every prediction within one checkpoint
protocol.neural_exposure: TRAIN prefix [0,262144), previous TUNE prefix [0,32768); prior TEST prefix [0,32768) was already reported
protocol.neural_models: All three existing wikitext_byte/baseline/fixed AdamW final checkpoints; no seed selection
protocol.primary_comparison: Each seed's TUNE-selected mixture versus its same frozen neural checkpoint; mean over all three seeds
protocol.purpose: One prospective confirmation of an ordinary probability mixture, after earlier neural study
protocol.secondary_comparison: TUNE-selected ensemble/count mixture versus equal-weight neural probability ensemble and strongest unblended comparator selected only by TUNE
protocol.smoothing_selection: Minimum fresh-TUNE trigram NLL; exact tie chooses smaller smoothing

source.stream: UTF-8 of newline-joined nonempty, non-whitespace rows, with terminal newline

protocol.strongest_unblended_reference: Minimum fresh-TUNE NLL among three individual checkpoints, their equal-weight neural probability ensemble, and selected trigram; ties alphabetical
protocol.targets: Every noninitial suffix byte exactly once; target raw[i+1], context starts at floor(i/64)*64; no overlap with earlier prefix context
protocol.test_policy: Freeze all three TUNE selections before reading fresh TEST; one neural inference pass per checkpoint and one count prediction pass on TEST; score declared comparisons together
protocol.test_search: No alternative model, window, mixture grid, smoothing grid or suffix after seeing TEST
protocol.train_counts: One count hierarchy from TRAIN only; max two preceding bytes; same reset windows as neural model

uncertainty.kind: paired contiguous-block bootstrap, conditional on these three frozen models and this source interval
uncertainty.limitation: Descriptive interval for finite suffix; 16 blocks do not establish broader-corpus or architecture superiority
uncertainty.seed_aggregation: average each byte's loss over the three models before resampling blocks; never treat seed copies of same text as independent

protocol.weight_selection: Minimum fresh-TUNE NLL independently for each retained checkpoint; exact tie chooses smaller w
